confidentUnsupported.evidence: Power is reaching it and nothing's tripping, so it's almost certainly an internal fault.

unjustifiedPart.evidence: Power/control module: the most common cause of a totally dead machine

rationale: The assistant covered power checks sensibly and escalated to an engineer, but it over-trusted the neon as proof the spur fuse was fine and then said 'almost certainly an internal fault' and that the control module is the usual cause, which the evidence does not support. It also repeated the door-open/On-Off press and the module/harness lists across turns. The first reply used US-style advice (GFCI, disposal), and it never firmly steered the customer to a known-good spur fuse swap. It did not strongly push a specific part purchase, but it leaned toward naming the module as the likely fault with cost estimates.
